name: Whale Cave
description: Crack in the cliff about 100 m north of the seaward end of the Inland Sea tunnel. The opening at 25 m is about 15 m wide and the crack, open to the sky along its whole length, runs about 80 m in, getting shallower towards the back. Also known as Għar in-Niexef or Audrey's Crack.
conditions: Watch out for swell, currents and the small tourist boats that enter the cave.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites. Position approximate.
